title: Completed CRISPR screens guide adaptive gene acquisition in new screens
description: ScreenPrior code for batch active learning in genome-scale CRISPR screens, including source-table preparation, an external-target runner and saved-result reporting. The companion study-data archive is separate. Original third-party gene tables, hit/tested masks, feature arrays and model checkpoints are not redistributed with this code.
